summary: 10.0.39.01 Server-Based Canonical Document Parity for Quotations, Returns & Notes
highlights: 1. Server-First Document Rendering Parity: Quotation, Sales Return, Purchase Return, and Credit/Debit Notes now call /api/documents/render for 100% desktop-identical PDF and Excel generation.
2. 2-Way Generation Flow: PDF Studio custom template check (Way 1) with seamless fallback to standard ProfessionalDocumentRenderer & ExcelTemplateRenderer (Way 2).
3. Email Dispatch with Generated PDF Attachment: Encodes rendered PDF blob to Base64 and dispatches via OperationsService with recipient email and attachmentBase64.
4. WhatsApp Action Support: Added WhatsApp document sharing flow to Sales & Purchase Return registers and slide drawers.
5. Sales Return Register Export Parity: Added Excel export button to view-sales-returns header matching Purchase Return register.
6. Resilient Client Fallbacks: DocumentPdfGenerator.js and DocumentExcelGenerator.js provide styled offline/client generation matching desktop starter workbook.
